import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    k = int(next(it))
    arr = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    even = 0
    odd = 0
    al = []
    for i in range(n):
        if i != 0:
            if even == odd:
                al.append(abs(arr[i] - arr[i-1]))
        if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1
    al.sort()
    count = 0
    for element in al:
        if element <= k:
            count += 1
            k -= element
        else:
            break
    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
